Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.video

Class VideoRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.video.VideoRenderer
public final class VideoRenderer extends Object
Deterministic frame renderer. No UI or real-time clock dependency.

Converts a global frame index to a scene-local clock and renders through Java2D. Incoming transitions combine independently rendered frames; no previous-frame simulation state is retained. A renderer owns bounded scene-backdrop caches and should be used by one rendering thread.
